title: Account-care daily slate (QBR + renewals)
content:
2026-03-25 — quick scratchpad for the day (pulling together QBR asks, renewal flags, and a handful of support follow-ups)

Top priorities (today):
- 09:30 prep slides for EkoHealth QBR (30m) — focus on latency reduction numbers from Dedicated trial and 2-min demo of live trace. Need latest per-route latency chart from Console exports (ask Maya).
- 11:00 EkoHealth QBR (60m) — objective: secure verbal OK to pilot Dedicated for Q3; primary blocker: procurement SOW questions. Bring fallback plan (hosted->dedicated migration timeline).
- Follow up on Renewal: AtlasRetail (renewal Apr 15) — confirm whether discounts apply if they commit to 6-mo reserved capacity. Legal tracking: RED-2073.

Account quick notes:
- EkoHealth (ARR ~$320k): health = amber, recent incidents: two 503s last week (root cause: autoscale config). Action: get eng runbook snippet and share with customer. Owner: Ethan. Risk: procurement timeline slipping. Ask: one-pager on data residency options for Private.
- AtlasRetail (ARR ~$120k): renewal discussion open. They use heavy batching; Optimize recs could save ~18% token cost. Tactic: propose pilot quantization profile + 5% discounted rate if they sign by Apr 10. Owner: me (Noah).
- Solace Payments (SMB): ticket backlog 3 items, priority on missing embeddings for search — engineering PR merged but needs deploy. Note: follow-up with release-engineering to schedule hotfix (ticket RE-881).

QBR slide checklist (quick):
- One-slide TL;DR: goals + ask (clear!)
- Performance: latency P50/P95 charts last 30d (Console export)
- Cost: before/after Optimize recs for sample workload
- Reliability: incident timeline + mitigations + fallback policy used
- Roadmap: Dedicated onboarding timeline + support SLA overview
- Open items & decisions needed (1 slide)

Emails / DM templates to send after QBR (draft bullets):
- Thank you + next steps (include dates for pilot kickoff, owners, and legal contact)
- Attach SOW draft link and KMS integration checklist

Action list (scratchy):
- [ ] Ping Maya for Console export + raw CSV for latency charts (due today 10:00)
- [ ] Draft AtlasRetail renewal proposal and pricing tiers (due Fri)
- [ ] Confirm hotfix window with release-eng for Solace (owner: release-eng lead)
- [ ] Add EkoHealth data residency FAQ to shared drive and link in follow-up mail
- [ ] Update RED-2073 with negotiated discount terms (legal looped)

Notes to self / open questions:
- Is there a short demo clip of streaming vs non-streaming for QBR? Might help explain user experience. If not, capture 30s clip during demo app run.
- Who owns the Dedicated onboarding checklist? (Product? Solutions Eng?) Need owner for timeline slide.

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm):
- Offer AtlasRetail a 6-week cost-savings audit with measurable KPIs; convert that audit into a short ROI slide for their CFO. Could speed renewal.
- For EkoHealth procurement, propose a 90-day escrowed SLA credit to reduce legal friction (small concession).

End-of-day quick tick: what went out / what to remind tomorrow:
- Sent: follow-up to Solace? (no)
- Reminder: prep backup demo if streaming demo flakiness shows up

-- Noah
